# E005 -- Apple Identity Guidelines (Channel Affiliates)

## Metadata
- **Source:** Apple_logo_guidelines.pdf
- **Brand:** Apple
- **Industry:** Technology
- **Year:** 2013 (March)
- **Pages Sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13
- **Total Pages:** 56
- **Document Type:** Identity Guidelines for Channel Affiliates and Apple-Certified Individuals

## Brand Strategy
- Partner/channel-focused guidelines (not Apple's internal brand guide)
- "The Apple identity is a seal of approval and a promise of excellence"
- Strict control: Apple reserves the right to withdraw permission at any time
- Must comply with Apple Authorized Reseller Agreement or Certification Agreement
- Channel signature must always be secondary to the partner's own business identity

## Logo
- **Apple logo never used alone** in channel affiliate communications -- always paired with logotype as a "channel signature"
- **Signature configurations:** One-line, Two-line, and Certification (with descriptor)
- Signature = Apple logo + logotype (e.g. "Authorized Reseller")
- Colors: Black or white only -- no other colors permitted
- Signature must be smaller than partner's business/store identity
- Preferred: only one Apple signature per page/surface
- Multiple authorizations: display logotype text only (without duplicating Apple logo) on capability/about pages; single authorization on ads/promotions
- **Strict prohibitions:**
  - Never use Apple logo standalone
  - Never alter artwork, font, spacing, or element relationships
  - No 3D rendering, rotation, animation, shadows, reflections, or glows
  - Do not incorporate into company identity or create combined logos
  - No decorative/pattern use of the signature
  - No registered trademark symbol next to the Apple logo

## Typography
- Channel signature uses specially designed type (Apple-controlled); partners cannot modify
- Specific font not named for partner use in sampled pages

## Color
- Signature reproduction: black or white only
- No color variations permitted for the channel signature

## Graphics / Iconography
- Not covered in sampled pages (channel-focused guide)

## Photography
- Not covered in sampled pages

## Applications
- Advertisements, websites, store signs, stationery, and other communications
- Multiple authorization display rules for web (About Us/Overview pages)
- Product promotions: single most relevant authorization only

## Tone of Voice
- Not covered (visual identity guide only)

## Outliers / Unique Elements
- This is a partner/channel guidelines document, not Apple's own brand guidelines -- focused on controlling third-party usage
- Extremely restrictive: partners cannot create any new treatments, must use only supplied artwork
- Multiple authorization display system: logotype-only listing to avoid duplicating the Apple logo
- Certification signatures awarded to individuals, not businesses
- Legal framework heavily integrated (Reseller Agreement, Certification Agreement, trademark guidelines)

## Quality Score
3 / 5
- Thorough 56-page guide for its specific purpose (channel partner identity control)
- Extremely detailed logo/signature usage rules with comprehensive do's/don'ts
- Limited value as a general brand reference -- no color palette, typography system, photography, or design language
- Highly restrictive/legal in nature rather than inspirational or creative
